Use this page to explore validation results for individual RSYC curves.
Choose a response, scale, spatial level, and model, then click an area on the
map. The map is coloured by the selected statistic. You can zoom with the
mouse wheel and drag to pan.

For the selected area, the left chart compares the national and regional
curves (black lines) with the plot means and their 95% confidence intervals
(red) for each 20-year age class. The right chart shows every validation
point for the selected model and level, with the selected area in red. Bias
is the RSYC prediction minus the plot mean. See
[Model validation](validation.html) for the method.

The address bar records the current selection, so you can share a link to
any view.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../validation/explorer.css">
<div id="rsyc-validation-explorer" data-base="../validation/"></div>
```
